− Proven finance and operations leader with 9+ years of experience, specializing in financial data analysis, securities operations, and process transformation across global teams.
− Assistant Vice President – Wells Fargo, leading a multi-location team of 14 professionals, driving operational excellence, workload optimization, and alignment with strategic business objectives.
− Expertise across asset and wealth management, including mutual funds trading, NAV calculations, trade lifecycle management, corporate actions, and retirement plan administration.
− Recognized for operational excellence, implementing robust quality control frameworks that reduced errors by 30%, enhancing client satisfaction and strengthening governance. Strategic and transformational thinker, utilizing advanced analytics tools such as Alteryx and Power BI to automate processes, improve efficiency, and support data-driven decision-making. Active contributor to organizational growth, participating in strategic projects, project presentations, and mentoring programs that enhance team performance and retention.
−
−
−
−
NOTABLE ACCOMPLISHMENTS & HIGHLIGHTS Spearheaded automation of manual trade processing workflows, resulting in a reduction of 22 hours per month and improving overall operational efficiency. Implemented advanced QC and error tracking mechanisms, reducing operational errors by 50%, thereby enhancing compliance and client satisfaction.
− Optimized team performance across India and US locations, achieving a 99%
improvement in SLA adherence for critical financial operations.
− Designed and deployed performance dashboards using Power BI and Alteryx, enabling real-time reporting and 50% faster decision-making for senior management. Led cross-functional process improvement initiatives that increased team productivity by 80%, while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards. − Mentored and developed 6+ junior team members, resulting in accelerated career
−
growth and reduced attrition within the team.
−

Spearheaded 3-4 process improvement initiatives, driving significant gains in production efficiency, reducing manual labor, and streamlining workflows, which led to a measurable increase in overall operational productivity. Led the successful migration and transition of manufacturing processes from the US to India, ensuring seamless process execution and operational alignment across both regions. Additionally, helped to optimize workflows and improve project delivery timelines within India.

projects.name: Wells Fargo – Process Transformation & Transition Management
projects.description:

Successfully transitioned new processes to India with zero defects, ensuring operational continuity.

Wells Fargo | | 2023 – Present Assistant Vice President • Manage a cross-location team of 14 members across India and the US, ensuring
optimal workload allocation and operational efficiency.
Conduct 100% quality checks for critical processes and perform sampling QC for selected workflows, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Track and report errors to senior management, driving accountability and

continuous improvement. Implement process automation using Alteryx and Power BI, reducing manual effort, mitigating risk, and improving operational efficiency.
Develop and maintain operational trackers, including error tracking, SLA adherence, volume analysis, and capacity planning. Lead process improvement initiatives to enhance workflow efficiency and meet stringent SLAs.

Lead Security Operation Specialist – Emerging Manager •
Led and managed a 20-member team in Mutual Funds trading under Asset & Wealth Management, ensuring high performance and accuracy.
Monitored NAV calculations, P&L posting, trade booking, and reconciliation for

mergers, acquisitions, tenders, and portfolio management. Coordinated cross-location teams (India, US, Manila, Philippines) to distribute workload effectively and meet strict market cutoffs.
Designed and maintained operational trackers, including attendance, leave, volume, error, SLA, and capacity analysis trackers.
Developed and implemented SOPs for all processes across locations, standardizing operations and reducing dependency.
Conducted process walkthroughs, hosted town halls, floor huddles, and team

engagement events to motivate and align teams. Initiated process improvements, enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and SLA compliance across operations.
JP Morgan | Senior Operational Analyst | 2021 – 2023 •
Processed corporate actions and SWIFT payments (MT564, MT566, MT567, MT202, and MT599) across multiple currencies.
Managed trade lifecycle operations, ensuring timely execution and adherence to market and internal policies.
Monitored and resolved internal and external trade breaks, improving settlement accuracy.
Collaborated on process enhancement initiatives, reducing manual effort and streamlining payment workflows.
Utilized BANCS, COSMIC, and TLM systems to execute trade settlements and reconciliations efficiently.
GreatWest Global – Empower | Senior Associate – Money Out | 2019 – 2020 •
Processed client retirement account transactions (401k, 403b, MRDs) via cheques and wire transfers. Investigated and resolved discrepancies or missing information, ensuring timely payment completion.

Ensured compliance with retirement plan policies and client specifications.
